run_process_adt_3dgs_online: run the script to convert Aria Digital Twin dataset to 3DGS format with online calibration
run_TimedPoses_get_matrix: run the TimedPoses class to get a 4x4 transformation matrix from timestamp index
run_TimedPoses_get_nearest_index: run the TimedPoses class to find the nearest pose index for a query timestamp
run_read_trajectory_csv_to_dict: run the function to read a trajectory CSV file and return a TimedPoses object
run_bisection_timestamp_search: run the bisection search to find the closest timestamp index in timed data
